info.description: Character, voice and knowledge base for the live avatar. Leave a field blank to fall back to the bundled George Anson defaults.

title.description: Full styling, e.g. Admiral of the Fleet, George Anson, 1st Baron Anson (1697-1762)

greeting.description: The first thing he says when a visitor connects.

personality.description: How he speaks: tone, register, answer length. One instruction per line.

boundaries.description: What he must refuse or deflect. One rule per line.

knowledge.description: Everything he is allowed to claim as fact. He is instructed not to go beyond this.

suggestedQuestions.description: Prompt chips shown to visitors, as a JSON array of strings.

contextId.description: LiveAvatar context_id. Filled in automatically on first run, or by `npm run liveavatar -- push-context`.

portrait.description: Still image shown before the stream connects.
